Class IdeResourceUI

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.resources.DefaultResourceUI
uno.anahata.asi.ide.ui.resources.IdeResourceUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResourceUI
public abstract class IdeResourceUI extends DefaultResourceUI
Universal IDE resource UI strategy.

Standardizes common IDE resource actions ("Open in Editor" and "Select in Project") for physical resources and provides unified path resolution for IdeHandle instances.

Author:
anahata
